side.guard_dog.speaker: Guard Dog
side.guard_dog.text: Woof. (One tail wag, as if to say: pay first.)

side.training_need_weapon.speaker: Narration
side.training_need_weapon.text: Get your blade sorted at Ding's first.

side.training_daily_cap.speaker: System
side.training_daily_cap.text: Today's training is full. Go to the hunt.

side.training_result.speaker: System
side.training_result.text: Power {power}. Forge the materials, or sell them to Amber.

side.weapon_rack_untasked.speaker: Narration
side.weapon_rack_untasked.text: A broken sword on the rack. The edge is old.

side.broken_blade_gone.speaker: Narration
side.broken_blade_gone.text: Nothing left here that Ding wants.

side.amber_has_letter.speaker: Amber
side.amber_has_letter.text: That letter? Give it to the chief. I only take gold.

side.amber_has_letter.speaker: Amber
side.amber_has_letter.text: Shop's open as usual. Forging materials, red draughts, all in stock.

side.amber_shop_open.speaker: Amber
side.amber_shop_open.text: The shop is open. I buy what drops, I sell what's missing.

side.amber_shop_open.speaker: Amber
side.amber_shop_open.text: Fight, sell to me, go forge. Even mercenaries keep accounts.

side.ronin_guard_fire.speaker: Black Flame Ronin
side.ronin_guard_fire.text: I guard the fire. Don't treat the flame as firewood.

side.ronin_guard_fire.speaker: Black Flame Ronin
side.ronin_guard_fire.text: If you fall, I drag you back. Once.

side.ronin_gone.speaker: Narration
side.ronin_gone.text: Only scorched boot prints left. The ronin is gone.

side.ronin_too_early.speaker: Black Flame Ronin
side.ronin_too_early.text: …Too early. Go fight your lion first.

side.ronin_defeated.speaker: Black Flame Ronin
side.ronin_defeated.text: …Strong… so what… the flame is still empty.

side.ding_debt_remind.speaker: Ding
side.ding_debt_remind.text: The broken sword is still at the training yard. Don't waste my time.
